simulated: the program id's keypair was not available (the build left BuyYBtw9U5tNwisNNiFgPfoc7eM44UbjCzbbv2toHAjR, not xJfKukbf9dCS98Sb1cuvFkRbjN4gC1f1SqMs3FhF14q): the fork writes the program at the declared id by cheatcode, which needs no secret key; on mainnet the deployer needs the id's keypair

the program bytes and the upgrade buffer were written with surfpool cheatcodes (surfnet_writeProgram, surfnet_setAccount) instead of `solana program deploy` / `write-buffer`, which surfpool cannot take (~2,400 write transactions); the authority changes and the upgrade itself are real loader instructions
a fresh surfpool fork of mainnet (clock, SOL airdrops)
fresh keys for the multisig members, the guardian and the keeper (mainnet: hardware wallets held by different people)
